review: Read all v2 patch and v3 delta. Original task creation, await, sleep, cancellation guards and session mutations remain in place.
Synchronous attempt scopes use immutable task IDs; deferred requests carry explicit parent links. Registry stores scalar identifiers only.
Load return/ready read existing let UUID, not lazy state or RealityKit entities.
Thirty-second window is anchored to recorded appearance, with separate bounded appearance arrival; no color prerequisite or retry.
limits: Synchronous diagnostic serialization and allocation may perturb scheduling.
Audio callback may have no request association until deferred dispatch.
A canceled Surface task before its original first guard has no load marker.
Task.sleep catch is an observed error path; taskCancelled distinguishes cancellation state.
This is not a production repair or runtime success claim.
